text: Techs run the visit and the stock on the truck. Here's what a technician sees, and what a lead tech adds.
The one thing to remember: a tech works their office's visits and stock. A lead tech also moves visits for the team, moves and wastes stock, and sees more reports.
This is Tess, a technician. No Settings, no Marketing.
Techs take payments and make the bank deposit.
She sees appointment and inventory reports.
there's no Void. Techs can't void or refund a payment.
Now Jess, our lead tech. She has Settings,
A lead tech can also reschedule or cancel anyone's visit, move stock between offices and vehicles, waste stock with a reason, and read the inventory activity log.
Jess is also a licensed technician, so she can sign quick visits and medical notes. That comes from the license, not the role.
The most common mistake is giving a tech the Technician role without an office, so they get no stock rights or tasks.
Remember: a tech works their office's visits and stock. A lead tech also runs the team's visits and stock.
